issues.title: Seated skirt or dress panel falls through the lap opening
issues.alsoAppliesTo: Every garment profileFor marks as span (skirts, dresses, gowns)
issues.expected: The skirt stays a single panel across the lap, covering what it covers when she is standing.
issues.actual: Skinning drops the bridging panel into the opening between the thighs. The opening is not inside either thigh, so the nearest-surface push leaves it there and the hem parts. On the two-thigh fixture the panel stays below the thighs (gap height under 0.43 m while the thigh tops are at 0.46 m) and the measured drop is 74 mm.
issues.reproducibility: deterministic on the fixture; live Try-On capture not yet run
issues.suspectedCause: Seated deformation or weight painting of the pencil skirt.
issues.confirmedCause: PoseClothCorrection only pushes a vertex that is inside a surface. A span vertex in the lap opening has a positive signed distance to both thighs, so it is never moved. Confirmed by running the same fixture with and without profile 'span'.
issues.proposedFix: Span profile: lift a bridging vertex back toward its rest until it sits on the support across both thighs.
issues.retest: Unit retest passed: with profile span, maxSpanDropMm goes from above 40 mm to under 8 mm and the quality gate accepts the result. Live before/after screenshots are still outstanding, so this is not marked fixed.
